articles.title: A 3-Year-Old Girl Is Britain's Oldest Northerner — And She Lived 11,000 Years Ago!
articles.summary: DNA from bones in a cave reveals a toddler girl was buried there 11,000 years ago. She is the oldest human ever found in northern Britain. Archaeologists also found jewelry, like a deer tooth, showing it was a careful burial.

articles.title: Venus and the Moon Put on a Dazzling Sky Show — See the Photos!
articles.summary: On May 18–19, a thin crescent moon and bright Venus appeared close together in the evening sky. Photographers around the world captured the pair above cities and forests. Earthshine made the dark part of the moon glow softly.

articles.title: Poop Detectives! How Scientists Are Saving the World's Rarest Marsupial
articles.summary: There are fewer than 150 Gilbert's potoroos left in the wild. Scientists studied their poop to find out what fungi they eat. This helps find new safe homes for these tiny, picky marsupials.
